Town of Flower Mound, Proposition A
c.q: The reauthorization of the local sales and use tax in the Town of Flower Mound, Texas at the rate of one-quarter of one percent (1/4 of 1%) to continue providing revenue for maintenance and repair of municipal streets. Eagle Mountain-Saginaw Independent School District, Proposition A
c.q: Ratifying the ad valorem tax rate of $1.2857 per $100 valuation in the Eagle Mountain-Saginaw Independent School District for the current year, a rate that will result in an increase of 5.23 percent in maintenance and operations tax revenue for the District for the current year as compared to the preceding year, which is an additional $6,159,156.

c.title: Eagle Mountain-Saginaw Independent School District, Proposition B
c.pre: THIS IS A PROPERTY TAX INCREASE
c.q: The issuance of bonds in the amount of $20,000,000 of Eagle Mountain-Saginaw Independent School District for the purpose of refunding all or a portion of the principal and/or interest on certain previously issued maintenance tax obligations of the District styled "Eagle Mountain-Saginaw Independent School District Maintenance Tax Notes, Series 2026", and the levying of a tax sufficient to pay the principal of and interest on the bonds.

c.title: City of Forest Hill, City Council
City of Forest Hill, Proposition A
c.q: Whether or not to reauthorize the local sales and use tax in the City of Forest Hill at the rate of one- fourth of one percent sales and use tax to continue providing revenue for maintenance and repair of municipal streets. The tax expires on the fourth anniversary of the date of this election unless the imposition of the tax is reauthorized.

c.title: City of Forest Hill, Proposition B
c.q: Shall the City Charter § 3.02 be amended to prohibit a recalled council member from serving in an elected or appointed city office for three years, instead of two years as currently written?

c.title: City of Forest Hill, Proposition C
c.q: Shall the City Charter § 3.10(3) be amended to require (rather than allow) the Council to adopt an ordinance or resolution further specifying procedures for investigations, notices, hearings, public reprimands, censures, and suspensions of the Mayor and/or a Council Member?

c.title: City of Forest Hill, Proposition D
c.q: Shall the City Charter § 4.02 be amended to change the maximum lawful severance pay for the position of City Manager from 60 days to 90 days in accordance with State law?

c.title: City of Forest Hill, Proposition E
c.q: Shall the City Charter § 4.04(i) be amended to require the City Manager to provide quarterly financial updates?

c.title: Keller Independent School District, Proposition A
